Abatement subsidies for groundwater conservation
abstract: Public programs that provide financial compensation for voluntary behavior have been widely used to incentivize the conservation of common property resources such as groundwater. Numerous existing groundwater conservation programs provide financial incentives to agricultural producers to permanently retire their groundwater use rights, ceasing irrigation from the associated well. This research estimates the net social benefits of a retirement policy and compares them to net benefits realized under a policy that provides subsidies for incremental reductions in groundwater use. Policies aimed at incremental groundwater use reductions have historically been ignored due, in part, to technological limitations for monitoring water use. Technological advancements make policies based on incremental changes in behavior feasible. We develop a theoretical model to compare water use behavior and welfare under the alternative policies. Then, we use a novel integrated assessment model to empirically illustrate the dynamic economic tradeoffs of the policies for a study area in Kansas. Our analysis shows that resource rents actually decrease under the retirement program relative to a baseline with no conservation policy. Further, subsidizing incremental reductions in groundwater use can dramatically increase the net social benefits of groundwater conservation relative to the retirement policy, but the choice of the subsidy policy parameters plays a critical role in determining its impact and cost to policymakers.
abstract_zh: 对自愿性行为提供经济补偿的公共计划，已被广泛用于激励地下水等公共池塘资源的保护。许多现有的地下水保护计划向农业生产者提供经济激励，使其永久性地放弃地下水使用权，停止使用相关水井进行灌溉。本研究估计了一项退出政策的社会净效益，并将其与一项为地下水使用量的增量减少提供补贴的政策所实现的净效益进行比较。以增量减少地下水使用为目标的政策，过去在很大程度上被忽视，部分原因在于用水监测的技术限制。而技术进步使得基于行为增量变化的政策成为可能。我们构建了一个理论模型，比较两种替代政策下的用水行为与福利。随后，我们利用一个新颖的综合评估模型，以堪萨斯州的一个研究区域为例，实证说明两种政策的动态经济权衡。我们的分析表明，相较于没有任何保护政策的基准情形，退出计划实际上会降低资源租金。此外，相较于退出政策，对地下水使用的增量减少给予补贴，可以显著提高地下水保护的社会净效益，但补贴政策参数的选择对其影响及政策制定者的成本起着关键作用。

title: Farm Production, Marketing, and Children's Nutritional Outcomes in Rural Zambia
Inland Flooding in the United States: A Review of Research Related to Risk Management, Economic Behavior, and Data Resources
abstract: Inland flooding is one of the most frequent and damaging natural disasters in the United States. Recent studies in the literature suggest that climate change will likely lead to an increase in the severity and frequency of inland flooding events in the U.S. We review the diverse literature on inland flooding to synthesize the current state of knowledge and to identify knowledge gaps. The topics covered include flood risk perception, insurance uptake, impact on property values, public mitigation strategies, behavioral responses to flooding, fatalities, and damages. We identify important gaps in the literature related to flood insurance demand, adoption of policies that encourage private and public investment in flood management, and flood risk management impacts in disadvantaged communities. Future research should identify factors that have decreased flood-related fatalities over time. Disentangling how infrastructure investments and better flood information improve outcomes during and after a flood could generate more effective tools and policies for mitigating damage from inland floods. Finally, creating and publishing comprehensive datasets that integrate economic, flood, and policy variables over space and time would facilitate future research on the economics of inland flooding. Our findings point to specific future research opportunities that would improve available databases, inform flood risk management strategies, and ultimately reduce the costs of inland floods.
abstract_zh: 内陆洪水是美国最频繁、破坏性最强的自然灾害之一。近期文献表明，气候变化可能会导致美国内陆洪水事件的严重程度和频率上升。我们回顾了关于内陆洪水的多样化文献，以梳理当前的知识状况并识别知识空白。综述涵盖的主题包括洪水风险认知、保险参与、对房产价值的影响、公共减灾策略、对洪水的行为反应、人员死亡和财产损失。我们发现，有关以下方面的文献存在重要空白：洪水保险需求、鼓励私人和公共投资于洪水管理的政策采纳，以及弱势社区中洪水风险管理的影响。未来研究应当识别随时间推移有助于减少洪水相关死亡人数的因素。厘清基础设施投资和更好的洪水信息如何在洪水期间和之后改善结果，可以产生更有效的减灾工具和政策。最后，编制并发布整合经济、洪水和政策变量的时空综合数据集，将有助于未来关于内陆洪水经济学的研究。我们的发现指出了具体的未来研究方向，这些方向将改善现有数据库，为洪水风险管理策略提供依据，并最终降低内陆洪水造成的损失。

Environmental and Natural Resource Economics and Systemic Racism
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article highlights some ways in which scholarly work in environmental and natural resource economics may be affected by, and may unintentionally further, racial inequity. We discuss four channels through which these effects may occur. The first is prioritization of efficiency over distribution. The second is inattention to procedural justice. The third involves abstraction away from crucial historical or social contexts. The fourth is a narrow focus on problems that fit neatly within existing analytical and empirical frameworks. We follow these threads through three areas in which we offer examples of how environmental and natural resource economics work may further racial inequity. The first involves methods of evaluating and measuring human and social welfare. The second relates to policy modeling choices. The third centers on analysis of management of the commons. We document opportunities to improve the field by better considering how racial inequity may affect, and be affected by, environmental and natural resource economic analysis. Scholars in this field have tools that can mitigate systemic racism in access to natural resources and a clean environment, but work must be done before that potential is realized.
abstract_zh: 本文阐述了环境与自然资源经济学的学术研究可能受到种族不平等影响，并可能在无意中加剧种族不平等的若干途径。我们讨论了可能产生这些影响的四种渠道：第一，优先考虑效率而忽视分配；第二，对程序正义的漠视；第三，脱离关键的历史或社会背景进行抽象分析；第四，过度聚焦于能够整齐地纳入既有分析与实证框架的问题。我们在三个领域中追踪这些线索，并举例说明环境与自然资源经济学研究可能如何加剧种族不平等：第一，人类与社会福利的评估和测度方法；第二，政策建模的选择；第三，公地管理的分析。我们指出，该领域可以通过更好地考虑种族不平等如何影响环境与自然资源经济分析，以及反过来受其影响，来改进研究。该领域的学者掌握着能够缓解自然资源获取和清洁环境方面系统性种族主义的工具，但要实现这一潜力，仍需付出大量工作。

title: Impact of randomly assigned 'pay-as-you-go' liquefied petroleum gas prices on energy use for cooking: Experimental pilot evidence from rural Rwanda
Integrated water management under different water rights institutions and population patterns: Methodology and application
abstract: While numerous studies have investigated demand management policies as a means of mitigating the impacts of climate change and population growth, little attention has been given to the interaction of spatial population patterns and water institutions that affect water shortages. In this article, we develop a methodology to evaluate how population location under alternative water institutions and climate scenarios impacts water demands, shortages, and derived economic values. We apply this methodology to the South Platte River Basin (SPRB) in Northeastern Colorado under three scenarios with ∼1,800 simulations. Results suggest that while water rights institutions have a negligible impact on total volumetric shortages relative to climate change, they have substantial distributional and economic implications. Results also suggest that continuous population growth in upstream cities yields the lowest water shortages if per capita use decreases with urbanization. However, if we assume that per capita demands do not decrease with population density, an equal distribution of population to upstream and downstream regions yields the lowest water shortage and highest economic value. These findings indicate the need that planning efforts must account for return flows and development patterns throughout a watershed in order to reduce water shortages and promote economic prosperity.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量研究探讨了需求管理政策在缓解气候变化和人口增长影响方面的作用，但对于空间人口格局与影响水资源短缺的水权制度之间相互作用的关注仍然不足。本文提出了一种方法，用以评估在不同水权制度和气候情景下，人口的空间分布如何影响用水需求、水资源短缺及由此产生的经济价值。我们将该方法应用于科罗拉多州东北部的南普拉特河流域（SPRB），在三种情景下进行了约1,800次模拟。结果表明，相对于气候变化的影响，水权制度对总体水量短缺几乎没有影响，但会产生显著的分配和经济后果。结果还表明，如果人均用水量随城镇化而下降，那么上游城市的持续人口增长将带来最低的水资源短缺。然而，如果假设人均需求不会随人口密度下降，那么将人口均衡分布于上游和下游地区，将带来最低的水资源短缺和最高的经济价值。这些发现表明，规划工作必须考虑整个流域内的回归水和开发格局，以减少水资源短缺并促进经济繁荣。

title: Assessment of vulnerability to water shortage in semi-arid river basins: The value of demand reduction and storage capacity
abstract: Interest in securing reliable water supplies has increased due to climate change and rapid population growth. This challenge is significant in growing areas with limited water supplies. To meet water demands, water managers are considering new storage infrastructure to increase the reliability of water supplies while also identifying opportunities to reduce water use per person. Although these strategies change water consumption patterns, their success at reducing shortages across space and time for different climate change scenarios remains unclear. In this paper, population- and climate-dependent future water supply and demand models are developed and integrated into a water allocation model calibrated for the South Platte River Basin of Colorado. Eight future climate scenarios are simulated using four statistically downscaled models from the Coupled Model Inter-Comparison Project Phase 5 (CMIP5) with two Representative Concentration Pathways (RCP). Lastly, findings from the water allocation model simulations are generalized beyond the study area using a novel approach by introducing dimensionless indices to characterize water shortage and basin conditions. Results reveal a threshold ratio of total storage capacity to mean water supply with a value of 0.64 above which additional storage has no effect on total water shortages. This threshold communicates the limitation of building storage infrastructure as a strategy to adapt to decreasing average water supplies for basins considering increasing storage capacity. However, basins with low current capacity are likely to fall below the threshold and could invest in reservoirs to mitigate future shortages.
abstract_zh: 由于气候变化和人口快速增长，确保可靠水源供应的需求日益增加。在水资源有限的快速发展地区，这一挑战尤为突出。为满足用水需求，水资源管理者正考虑建设新的蓄水设施以提高供水可靠性，同时也在探索减少人均用水量的机会。尽管这些策略会改变用水模式，但它们在不同气候变化情景下，能否减少跨空间和跨时间的水资源短缺，仍不明确。本文构建了依赖人口和气候的未来供需模型，并将其纳入针对科罗拉多州南普拉特河流域校准的水资源分配模型中。我们使用耦合模式比较计划第五阶段（CMIP5）中四个经统计降尺度的模式，结合两种代表性浓度路径（RCP），模拟了八种未来气候情景。最后，我们引入无量纲指数来刻画水资源短缺和流域状况，从而将水资源分配模型的模拟结果推广至研究区域之外，这是一种新颖的方法。结果显示，存在一个总蓄水容量与平均供水量之比的阈值，其值为0.64；超过该阈值后，增加蓄水容量对总体水资源短缺不再有影响。这一阈值表明，在平均供水量下降的情况下，以建设蓄水设施作为适应策略存在局限。然而，当前蓄水能力较低的流域很可能低于该阈值，因此可以考虑投资水库以缓解未来的水资源短缺。

title: Counterfactual Scenarios Reveal Historical Impact of Cropland Management on Soil Organic Carbon Stocks in the United States
abstract: Natural climate solutions provide opportunities to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and the United States is among a growing number of countries promoting storage of carbon in agricultural soils as part of the climate solution. Historical patterns of soil organic carbon (SOC) stock changes provide context about mitigation potential. Therefore, our objective was to quantify the influence of climate-smart soil practices on SOC stock changes in the top 30 cm of mineral soils for croplands in the United States using the DayCent Ecosystem Model. We estimated that SOC stocks increased annually in US croplands from 1995 to 2015, with the largest increase in 1996 of 16.6 Mt C (95% confidence interval ranging from 6.1 to 28.2 Mt CO2 eq.) and the lowest increase in 2015 of 10.6 Mt C (95% confidence interval ranging from − 1.8 to 22.2 Mt C). Most climate-smart soil practices contributed to increases in SOC stocks except for winter cover crops, which had a negligible impact due to a relatively small area with cover crop adoption. Our study suggests that there is potential for enhancing C sinks in cropland soils of the United States although some of the potential has been realized due to past adoption of climate-smart soil practices.
abstract_zh: 自然气候解决方案为减少温室气体排放提供了机会，美国是越来越多地推动将碳储存于农业土壤中、作为气候解决方案之一的国家之一。土壤有机碳（SOC）储量的历史变化，为减缓潜力提供了背景信息。因此，我们的目标是利用DayCent生态系统模型，量化气候智慧型土壤管理措施对美国耕地表层30厘米矿质土壤中SOC储量变化的影响。我们估计，1995至2015年间，美国耕地的SOC储量逐年增加，其中1996年增幅最大，为1,660万吨碳（95%置信区间为610万至2,820万吨二氧化碳当量），2015年增幅最小，为1,060万吨碳（95%置信区间为−180万至2,220万吨碳）。除冬季覆盖作物外，大多数气候智慧型土壤管理措施都促进了SOC储量的增加；冬季覆盖作物的影响可忽略不计，原因是采用覆盖作物的面积相对较小。我们的研究表明，美国耕地土壤的碳汇具有提升潜力，但由于过去已采用气候智慧型土壤管理措施，部分潜力已经得以实现。

title: Impact of Weather Shocks on Food Security: How Effective are Forests as Natural Insurance?
abstract: Malnutrition and food insecurity affect nearly one billion people worldwide. In developing countries, adverse weather shocks exacerbate these challenges by reducing agricultural productivity. Rural households often rely on forests for food. We determine whether forest access is associated with a less severe effect of adverse weather shocks on food security in rural Malawi. Exploiting exogenous variation in weather shocks and predetermined forest access, we find that households without forest access experience drops in food security when confronted with shocks, while forest access is associated with insignificant changes in food security. This suggests that forests are used as natural insurance. For the period considered by the study, we find that most of the negative impact of shocks was driven by floods, which were more prevalent and severe than droughts. In addition, we find evidence that the role of forests as natural insurance improves with increased forest density (canopy cover). There is a minimum forest density threshold below which forests are not associated with natural insurance. These results suggest that efforts to protect forests should consider their natural insurance role, particularly in regions with weak social safety nets.
abstract_zh: 全球近十亿人面临营养不良和粮食不安全问题。在发展中国家，不利的天气冲击会降低农业生产力，从而加剧这些挑战。农村家庭往往依赖森林获取食物。我们考察了在马拉维农村地区，获得森林资源是否与不利天气冲击对粮食安全的较弱影响相关。利用天气冲击的外生变异以及预先确定的森林可及性，我们发现，没有森林可及性的家庭在遭遇冲击时粮食安全水平下降，而拥有森林可及性的家庭，其粮食安全变化并不显著。这表明森林被用作一种天然保险。在本研究所考察的时期，我们发现冲击造成的负面影响大部分由洪水驱动，洪水比干旱更为普遍、也更为严重。此外，我们发现，随着森林密度（冠层覆盖度）的增加，森林作为天然保险的作用会增强。存在一个最低森林密度阈值，低于该阈值时，森林与天然保险之间不存在关联。这些结果表明，保护森林的努力应当考虑森林的天然保险作用，在社会安全网薄弱的地区尤其如此。

title: Optimal R&D investment in the management of invasive species
Policy Challenges to Enhance Soil Carbon Sinks: The Dirty Part of Making Contributions to the Paris Agreement by the United States
abstract: The U.S. government is planning significant reductions in greenhouse gas emissions as part of their nationally determined contribution to the Paris Agreement. The plan includes a variety of activities, one of which is enhancing carbon sinks in soils through a climate-smart agriculture program. The nature of soil carbon along with market forces, cultural factors and other issues create challenges for a program in climate-smart agriculture. These challenges include quantification of soil carbon sequestration, targeting practice adoption that is additional to past adoption, and ensuring that emissions of other greenhouse gases do not increase with climate-smart practices. In addition, there are challenges associated with maintaining carbon storage in soils over a long-time horizon; and avoiding increases in greenhouse gas emissions on non-participating lands. We review and discuss options for addressing challenges with direct regulations, subsidies and tax incentives, carbon taxes, and carbon credit offsets. None of these policy interventions are likely to overcome all challenges, but there are ways to limit risks that challenges pose to each intervention. The ability of the U.S. government to limit or mitigate these risks through careful design of a climatesmart agriculture program will largely determine how much carbon is sequestered in soils, and associated contributions to their emissions reduction goal for the Paris Agreement.
abstract_zh: 作为履行《巴黎协定》国家自主贡献的一部分，美国政府计划大幅减少温室气体排放。该计划包括多项措施，其中之一是通过气候智慧型农业项目来增强土壤中的碳汇。土壤碳的自然属性，以及市场力量、文化因素和其他问题，都给气候智慧型农业项目带来了挑战。这些挑战包括：土壤固碳的量化；瞄准那些相对于过去采用情况而言属于新增的措施；以及确保采用气候智慧型措施时其他温室气体的排放不会增加。此外，在长期时间范围内维持土壤碳储存，以及避免非参与土地上温室气体排放增加，也面临挑战。我们综述并讨论了应对这些挑战的几种途径，包括直接监管、补贴与税收激励、碳税以及碳信用抵消。没有任何一种政策干预能够克服全部挑战，但有一些方法可以限制这些挑战对各项干预措施构成的风险。美国政府能否通过精心设计气候智慧型农业项目来限制或减轻这些风险，将在很大程度上决定土壤中固存的碳量，以及其对实现《巴黎协定》减排目标的相应贡献。

title: Ecosystem Services and Land Rental Markets: Producer Costs of Bat Population Crashes
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Nonmarket natural capital provides crucial inputs across the economy. We use land rental market data to calculate the welfare impacts of a change in an unpriced natural capital while accounting for spatial spillovers. We apply the welfare analysis to examine the cost of white-nose syndrome (WNS) in bats, which provide pest control services to agricultural producers. WNS, a disease that decimates bat populations, arrived in the United States in the mid-2000s. Leveraging the exogenous change in bat populations, we find that the loss of bats in a county causes land rental rates to fall by $2.84 per acre plus $1.50 per acre per neighboring county with WNS. Agricultural land falls by 1,102 acres plus 582 acres per neighboring county with WNS. As of 2017, agricultural losses from WNS were between $426 and $495 million per year. These estimates of ecosystem service values can inform public management of society’s natural capital.
abstract_zh: 非市场自然资本为整个经济提供了关键投入。我们利用土地租赁市场数据，在考虑空间溢出效应的情况下，计算未定价自然资本变化的福利影响。我们应用该福利分析，考察蝙蝠白鼻综合征（white-nose syndrome, WNS）的成本。蝙蝠为农业生产者提供害虫防治服务。白鼻综合征是一种会大量杀死蝙蝠的疾病，于2000年代中期传入美国。利用蝙蝠种群的外生变化，我们发现，一个县蝙蝠数量的减少会使土地租金下降每英亩2.84美元，相邻每个有白鼻综合征的县再使租金下降每英亩1.50美元。农业用地减少1,102英亩，相邻每个有白鼻综合征的县再减少582英亩。截至2017年，白鼻综合征造成的农业损失为每年4.26亿至4.95亿美元。这些生态系统服务价值的估计，可为社会自然资本的公共管理提供参考。

Policy Leakage or Policy Benefit? Spatial Spillovers from Conservation Policies in Common Property Resources
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Voluntary, incentive-based policies are often offered to resource users to address the overexploitation of common property resources. Spillovers from these policies have important implications for policy effectiveness. Considering different externalities that can affect producers’ irrigation decisions, we investigate whether permanently retiring groundwater rights impacts groundwater use among active neighboring groundwater users. We find that enrollment in the retirement program causes neighboring wells to initially pump less groundwater on average. However, water use reductions are only temporary, due to relative increases in stock levels over time. The results imply that policies that retire water rights may conserve more water than anticipated in the short term, but, over time, higher resource stocks could lead to policy leakage. We also present evidence that the decrease in groundwater use is driven by the shared resource stock. Our results provide empirical evidence for the importance of spatial spillovers related to common property resource management.
abstract_zh: 自愿性的激励型政策常被用于解决资源使用者对公共池塘资源的过度开发问题。这些政策的外溢效应对政策效果具有重要影响。考虑到可能影响生产者灌溉决策的不同外部性，我们考察了永久性退出地下水使用权是否会影响邻近活跃地下水用户的地下水使用。我们发现，参与退出计划会使邻近水井在初期平均抽取的地下水减少。然而，由于随着时间推移地下水储量相对增加，用水量的减少只是暂时的。研究结果表明，退出水权的政策在短期内可能比预期更能节约用水，但从长期来看，较高的资源储量可能导致政策泄漏。我们还提供证据表明，地下水使用量的减少是由共享的资源储量所驱动的。我们的研究结果为空间外溢效应在公共池塘资源管理中的重要性提供了实证依据。

title: An Economic and Biophysical Model of Deficit Irrigation
abstract:
Competition for scarce water resources may lead to high water prices. Agricultural producers can adapt to increasing water price by adjusting irrigation management strategies. When water prices are high, deficit irrigation, the purposeful reduction of irrigation to reduce water use while accepting reduced yield, may increase net income. Deficit irrigation decisions depend on economic, biological, and physical conditions. A model based on relationships among the amount and cost of irrigation water applied, water productivity, and the value of water saved and crop yield was developed to assist farmers making deficit irrigation decisions. A model application for irrigated maize (Zia mays L.) production in northeast Colorado illustrates conditions under which deficit irrigation increases net income. High water costs and low crop prices favor deficit irrigation. When water has value for leasing, the combination of deficit irrigation production to reduce water use and water leasing may increase net income. Sufficiently high lease prices and low commodity prices favor rainfed production or fallowing.
Core Ideas
Deficit irrigation may increase net farm income.
Expensive water, low crop prices, and high elasticity of water productivity favor deficit irrigation.
Combining economic with biophysical models improves applicability.
abstract_zh:
稀缺水资源的竞争可能导致水价上涨。农业生产者可以通过调整灌溉管理策略来适应水价上涨。当水价较高时，亏缺灌溉（即有意减少灌溉以节约用水，同时接受减产）可能提高净收入。亏缺灌溉的决策取决于经济、生物和物理条件。我们建立了一个模型，考察灌溉水的使用量与成本、水分生产力、节约用水的价值以及作物产量之间的关系，以帮助农民做出亏缺灌溉决策。针对科罗拉多州东北部灌溉玉米（Zia mays L.）生产的模型应用表明，在哪些条件下亏缺灌溉能够提高净收入：高水价和低作物价格有利于亏缺灌溉。当水资源具有租赁价值时，亏缺灌溉减少用水与水权租赁相结合，可能提高净收入。足够高的租赁价格和较低的商品价格，则有利于雨养生产或休耕。
核心观点
亏缺灌溉可能提高农场净收入。
昂贵的水价、低作物价格以及水分生产力的高弹性有利于亏缺灌溉。
将经济模型与生物物理模型相结合可提高适用性。

title: Complements of the House: Estimating Demand-side Linkages between Residential Water and Electricity
Determinants of the marginal willingness to pay for improved domestic water and irrigation in partially electrified Rwandan villages
venue: International Journal of Sustainable Development and World Ecology
abstract: Access to water for domestic and irrigation uses remains limited across Sub-Saharan Africa, particularly in rural areas. While the technical feasibility of implementing innovative technologies to improve water supply has been often evaluated, less is known about the drivers that motivate users to pay for obtaining the inherent benefits of improved water supply. In this article, the determinants of the marginal willingness to pay (mWTP) for improved domestic and irrigation water are investigated. For this purpose, a contingent valuation study is performed in rural Rwanda. This study uses survey data from 316 households situated in 8 villages, in which ~20% of the households receive electricity thanks to microgrids powered by solar energy. It is found that the mWTP for improved domestic water supply is influenced by the proportion of children in the household, business ownership, and satisfaction with water quantity and quality. The mWTP for irrigation is determined by respondent education, business ownership and crop area planted. This paper contributes to the literature by allowing a comparison of the determinants of the mWTP for improved domestic water supply to the determinants of the mWTP for irrigation. Another contribution is to examine the mWTP for improved water infrastructure in partially electrified villages. Identifying areas with high marginal benefits from water can guide infrastructure investment and electrification efforts while improving well-being and increasing revenues in rural areas.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区，尤其是农村地区，用于生活和灌溉的水源供应仍然有限。尽管改善供水的创新技术的技术可行性经常得到评估，但人们对于是什么因素促使用户为获取改善供水所带来的收益而付费，了解仍然较少。本文考察了改善生活用水和灌溉用水的边际支付意愿（mWTP）的决定因素。为此，我们在卢旺达农村地区开展了一项条件价值评估（CVM）研究。该研究使用了来自8个村庄316户家庭的调查数据，其中约20%的家庭通过太阳能驱动的微电网获得电力。研究发现，改善生活供水的边际支付意愿受家庭中儿童比例、是否拥有企业以及对水量和水质的满意度影响。灌溉的边际支付意愿则由受访者的教育程度、是否拥有企业以及种植面积决定。本文的贡献在于比较了改善生活用水与改善灌溉用水的边际支付意愿决定因素，并考察了在部分电气化村庄中改善水利基础设施的边际支付意愿。识别出用水边际收益较高的地区，可以指导基础设施投资和电气化努力，同时改善农村地区的福祉并增加收入。

title: Private Actions and Preferences for Coordinated Groundwater Conservation in Colorado's Republican River Basin
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association
abstract: Conservation of groundwater resources is critical for maintaining the future productivity of irrigated land in the Ogallala Aquifer Region and beyond. This research explores motivations and behavior related to groundwater conservation among agricultural producers in the Colorado portion of the Republican River Basin, which is part of the Ogallala Aquifer. The empirical modeling uses data from a recently conducted survey to analyze how a common set of producer, farm, and resource characteristics influence groundwater values, concern for future groundwater availability, private conservation actions, and support for coordinated conservation efforts. We find two factors, producer age and land owner status, are consistently correlated with the key conservation‐related outcomes we evaluate. More generally, the results suggest considerable similarities in the characteristics that drive private conservation actions and support for coordinated conservation. This knowledge could be used to better target and incentivize future groundwater conservation efforts in the region. Editor's note: This paper is part of the featured series on Optimizing Ogallala Aquifer Water Use to Sustain Food Systems. See the February 2019 issue for the introduction and background to the series.
abstract_zh: 保护地下水资源对于维持奥加拉拉含水层地区及其他地区灌溉土地的未来生产力至关重要。本研究探讨了科罗拉多州共和河流域（位于奥加拉拉含水层范围内）的农业生产者在地下水保护方面的动机与行为。实证模型利用近期开展的一项调查数据，分析了一组共同的生产者、农场和资源特征如何影响地下水价值、对未来地下水可得性的担忧、私人保护行动，以及对协调保护努力的支持。我们发现，生产者年龄和土地所有者身份这两个因素，与我们所评估的关键保护相关结果持续相关。更一般地说，结果表明，驱动私人保护行动的特征与支持协调保护的特征之间存在相当大的相似性。这些知识可用于更好地瞄准并激励该地区未来的地下水保护努力。编者按：本文是“优化奥加拉拉含水层用水以维持粮食系统”专题系列的一部分。该系列的导论与背景介绍见2019年2月刊。

title: The Impact of Institutional and Land Use Change on Local Incomes in Chilean Patagonia
abstract: Many developing rural economies depend on natural capital stocks for generating income and wealth. However, common property natural resources are often over-exploited. One method of solving over-exploitation is privatisation of the resource. In Palena, Chile, the privatisation of common-property grazing land facilitated a change in land use from grazing to tourism activities. We present a theoretical model that demonstrates that privatisation that leads to land use change has the potential to increase local wages. To resolve theoretical ambiguities, we calibrate a local general equilibrium model and find that privatisation and a switch to tourism resulted in higher wages in the local economy of Palena. This finding contributes to the ongoing investigation of the local costs and benefits of resource privatisation in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 许多发展中国家的农村经济依赖自然资本存量来创造收入和财富。然而，公共产权的自然资源常常被过度开发。解决过度开发问题的一种方法是将资源私有化。在智利的帕莱纳（Palena），共有草场的私有化促使土地用途从放牧转向旅游活动。我们提出了一个理论模型，证明导致土地用途改变的私有化有可能提高当地工资。为解决理论上的模糊性，我们校准了一个局部一般均衡模型，发现帕莱纳的私有化及向旅游业的转变提高了当地经济的工资水平。这一发现为正在进行的关于发展中国家资源私有化的地方成本与收益的研究做出了贡献。

Climate Change and Labor Allocation in Mexico: Evidence from Annual Fluctuations in Weather

Is Sustainable Intensification Possible? Evidence from Ethiopia
abstract: This paper explores the sustainable intensification possibilities facing smallholder farmers in Ethiopia. We examine the internal consistency of jointly achieving “sustainable” “intensification” by exploring the factors that lead to complementarity or tradeoffs in the outcomes. A cross-sectional survey of farms was examined in multiple regions of Ethiopia’s Highlands. The results show that some farmers can achieve both sustainability and intensification, while many do not, or cannot achieve both at the same time. We found that some actions have a common impact on both sustainability and intensification, while other factors only affect one outcome. Access to agricultural loans and farm mechanization significantly increases the likelihood of succeeding in sustainable intensification. Access to land will be critical for agricultural sustainability while access to farming information and technical services will drive agricultural intensification. Overall, opportunities to improve both sustainability and intensification are weak, but the opportunity to improve one without sacrificing the other are realistic. The results contribute to the ongoing debate on sustainable intensification and help policy makers explore alternatives for managing different intensification and sustainability scenarios to achieve agricultural development goals.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了埃塞俄比亚小农面临的可持续集约化可能性。我们考察了“可持续”与“集约化”这两个目标能否在内部一致地同时实现，并分析了导致结果之间存在互补或权衡关系的因素。我们在埃塞俄比亚高地的多个地区对农场进行了横截面调查。结果表明，一些农民能够同时实现可持续性与集约化，而许多农民则做不到，或无法同时实现两者。我们发现，有些行动对可持续性和集约化都有共同影响，而另一些因素则只影响其中一个结果。获得农业贷款和农业机械化显著提高了成功实现可持续集约化的可能性。获得土地对农业可持续性至关重要，而获得农业信息和技术服务则将推动农业集约化。总体而言，同时改善两者的机会较为有限，但在不牺牲另一方的前提下改善其中一方，则是现实可行的。本研究结果有助于推进关于可持续集约化的讨论，并帮助政策制定者探索不同集约化与可持续性情景下的替代方案，以实现农业发展目标。

title: Retiring Land to Save Water: Participation in Colorado's Republican River Conservation Reserve Enhancement Program
abstract: Agricultural land retirement is increasingly used to manage water resources. This study uses well-level enrollment data to explore the factors that influence landowner participation in the Colorado Republican River Conservation Reserve Enhancement Program. An empirical model of enrollment is informed by a theoretical model of participation that incorporates aquifer and soil characteristics in addition to financial incentives. Our results reveal that enrollment is predicted to increase by 0.087 percentage points with a $10 increase in the incentives offered. The probability of enrollment is also influenced by the aquifer’s saturated thickness and the soil characteristics that impact land productivity. (JEL Q25)
abstract_zh: 农业土地退耕正越来越多地被用于水资源管理。本研究利用井一级的入保数据，探讨影响土地所有者参与科罗拉多共和河保护储备增强计划（Colorado Republican River Conservation Reserve Enhancement Program）的因素。入保的实证模型以参与的理论模型为依据，该理论模型除财政激励外，还纳入了含水层和土壤特征。结果显示，每提供10美元的激励，入保率预计将提高0.087个百分点。含水层的饱和厚度以及影响土地生产力的土壤特征，也会影响入保概率。（JEL Q25）

title: State Severance Tax Competition and the Division of Natural Resource Rents
Values and Groundwater Management in the Ogallala Aquifer Region
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: The Ogallala Aquifer supports agricultural production and rural communities across eight US states, but the aquifer is being depleted in many areas. Depletion has continued despite numerous institutional and policy interventions, indicating that research and policy have not resulted in physical stabilization of the valuable common pool resource. We argue that explicit inquiry into the values motivating groundwater use and management is critical to conservation efforts. In this paper, we review and integrate prior social science research in the Ogallala region, drawing attention to areas where prior research considers values, implicitly or explicitly, and pointing to new or re-emerging areas for research into the relationship between human values and groundwater use, conservation, and management.
abstract_zh: Ogallala含水层为美国八个州的农业生产和农村社区提供支撑，但该含水层在许多地区正在被耗竭。尽管采取了大量制度和政策干预，耗竭仍在持续，这表明研究与政策并未实现对这一宝贵公共池塘资源的物理稳定。我们认为，明确探讨驱动地下水使用与管理的价值观，对于保护工作至关重要。在本文中，我们回顾并整合了Ogallala地区既有的社会科学研究，指出既有研究在哪些方面（隐含或明确地）考虑了价值观，并指出人类价值观与地下水使用、保护和管理之间关系的新兴或重新兴起的研究领域。

title: A Multidisciplinary Research Framework on School Environment, Occupant Health and Performance
Dilemmas, Coordination and Defection: How Uncertain Tipping Points Induce Common Pool Resource Destruction
Evaluating the Effect of Conservation Motivations on Residential Water Demand
Mitigating Climate Change in Africa: Barriers to Financing Low-Carbon Development
Producer Responses to Surface Water Availability and Implications for Climate Change Adaptation
abstract: Climate change is predicted to bring changes in weather and water availability. The effect on agriculture depends on the ability of producers to modify their practices in response to changing distributions. We develop a two-stage theoretical model of planting and irrigation decisions and use a unique dataset to empirically estimate how producers respond to changes in expected water availability and deviations from expectations. As water supplies decrease, producers respond by planting fewer acres and concentrating the application of water. Highlighting the importance of adaptation in this context, failure to account for this behavioral response overstates climate change impacts by 17%. (JEL Q15, Q25)
abstract_zh: 气候变化预计将改变天气和水资源可得性。其对农业的影响取决于生产者根据变化的分布调整生产行为的能力。我们构建了一个关于种植和灌溉决策的两阶段理论模型，并利用一个独特的数据集，实证估计了生产者如何应对预期水资源可得性的变化及偏离预期的情况。随着供水减少，生产者的反应是减少种植面积，并集中施用水分。这凸显了适应在此背景下的重要性：若不考虑这种行为反应，气候变化影响将被高估17%。（JEL Q15, Q25）

title: The Heterogeneous Impacts of Groundwater Management Policies in the Republican River Basin of Colorado
abstract: Groundwater is a critical input to agricultural production across the globe. Current groundwater pumping rates frequently exceed recharge, often by a substantial amount, leading to groundwater depletion and potential declines in agricultural profits over time. As a result, many regions reliant on irrigated agriculture have proposed policies to manage groundwater use. Even when gains from aquifer management exist, there is little information about how policies affect individual producers sharing the resource. In this paper, we investigate the variability of groundwater management policy impacts across heterogeneous agricultural producers. To measure these impacts, we develop a hydroeconomic model that captures the important role of well capacity, productivity of water, and weather uncertainty. We use the model to simulate the impacts of groundwater management policies on producers in the High Plains aquifer of eastern Colorado and compare outcomes to a no‐policy baseline. The management policies considered include a pumping fee, a quantity restriction, and an irrigated acreage fee. We find that well capacity and soil type affect policy impacts but in ways that can qualitatively differ across policy type. Model results have important implications for the distributional impacts and political acceptability of groundwater management policies.
abstract_zh: 地下水是全球农业生产的关键投入。当前的地下水抽取量常常超过补给量，且超出幅度往往相当大，由此导致地下水枯竭，并可能使农业利润随时间推移而下降。因此，许多依赖灌溉农业的地区都提出了管理地下水使用的政策。即便含水层管理确有收益，人们对政策如何影响共享该资源的个体生产者仍知之甚少。在本文中，我们考察了地下水管理政策影响在异质性农业生产者之间的差异。为衡量这些影响，我们构建了一个水文经济模型，刻画了井容量、水的生产率以及天气不确定性的重要作用。我们利用该模型模拟地下水管理政策对科罗拉多州东部高平原含水层生产者的影响，并将结果与无政策的基准情形进行比较。所考虑的管理政策包括抽水费、数量限制和灌溉面积费。我们发现，井容量和土壤类型会影响政策效应，但其影响方式在不同政策类型之间可能存在质的差异。模型结果对地下水管理政策的分配效应和政治可接受性具有重要含义。

title: Water Storage in a Changing Environment: The Impact of Allocation Institutions on Value
abstract: As populations increase in arid regions of the world, investment in water infrastructure improves resource management by increasing control over the location and timing of water allocation. Many studies have explored freer trade as a substitute for additional infrastructure investment. We instead quantify how water allocation institutions, reservoir management objectives, and storage capacity influence the value derived from a reservoir system. We develop a stochastic dynamic programming model of a reservoir system that faces within‐year variation in weather‐dependent water demand as well as stochastic semiannual inflows. We parameterize the model using the Colorado‐Big Thompson system, which transports stored water from the West Slope of the Rocky Mountains to the East Slope. We then evaluate the performance of the system under five institutional settings. Our results suggest that rigid allocation mechanisms and inefficient management objectives result in a decrease of up to 13% in the value generated from stored water when compared to a free trade scenario, an impact on par with predicted losses associated with climate‐change‐induced inflow reductions. We also find that under biased management objectives, increasing storage capacity can decrease the social value obtained from stored water.
abstract_zh: 随着世界干旱地区人口增长，水利基础设施投资通过增强对水资源配置的时间和空间控制，改善了资源管理。许多研究探讨了以更自由的贸易替代额外基础设施投资的可能性。本文则量化了水资源配置制度、水库管理目标和蓄水能力如何影响水库系统所产生的价值。我们构建了一个随机动态规划模型，该模型刻画了水库系统面临的年内受天气影响的用水需求变化，以及随机的半年度入流。我们以科罗拉多—大汤普森（Colorado-Big Thompson）系统为参数校准对象，该系统将储存的水从落基山脉西坡输送至东坡。随后，我们评估了系统在五种制度安排下的表现。结果表明，僵化的配置机制和低效的管理目标，与自由贸易情景相比，会使储存水所产生的价值减少多达13%，其影响与气候变化导致入流减少所带来的预测损失相当。我们还发现，在管理目标存在偏差的情况下，增加蓄水能力反而会降低储存水所获得的社会价值。

title: Optimizing Rural Village Micro Grids to Provide Affordable and Reliable Renewable Electricity in Developing Countries: An Application to Rwanda
Are Two Rents better than None? When Monopolies Correct ill-defined Property Rights
Consumer Preferences for Fixed versus Variable Quantities of Electricity: Joint Estimation of Contingent Quantity and Valuation Methods
abstract: The structure of stated preference questions to value consumption from public infrastructure can vary depending on the conditions of consumption facing the household. Specifically, a good could be offered as a quasi-public or quasi-private good. This paper demonstrates how consumption from two alternative electricity allocation options can be valued using two types of stated preference questions. Since surveyed households were asked two types of questions, the authors develop a joint model of a contingent valuation question and a contingent quantity behavior response that allows for correlation in error terms across models. In their application to two villages in Rwanda, the authors find higher WTP for electricity consumed as a quasi-private good rather than a quasi-public good, with four hours of electricity per day, only in the evening. They also find correlation in the error terms across the two models, suggesting that their joint estimator is more efficient than estimating each model individually.
abstract_zh: 为评估公共基础设施的消费价值而设计的陈述偏好问题的结构，会因家庭面临的消费条件不同而有所差异。具体而言，一种商品既可以作为准公共物品提供，也可以作为准私人物品提供。本文展示了如何利用两类陈述偏好问题，对两种替代性电力分配方案的消费进行估价。由于受访家庭被问及两类问题，作者构建了一个条件价值评估问题与条件数量行为反应的联合模型，允许两个模型的误差项相关。在卢旺达两个村庄的应用中，作者发现，人们对作为准私人物品消费的电力的支付意愿高于作为准公共物品消费的电力，前提是每天仅在晚上提供四小时电力。他们还发现，两个模型的误差项之间存在相关性，表明其联合估计量比单独估计每个模型更有效。
